svg.text: Configured alerts for the Orders application:
A1: P95 response time > 800 ms for 10 min → notify #oncall (SEV: high)
A2: error rate > 2% for 5 min → create ticket (SEV: medium)
A3: policy violations (rate-limit 429) count > 100 in 1 h → email owners (SEV: low)
A4: heap usage > 85% for 15 min → notify #platform (SEV: medium)
All alerts evaluate metrics collected per application and per API instance.
